first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding best addresses both current activation and completion declines, with two inherited records suggesting durable early-adoption gains. Promotional pricing directly counters the competitor, but its long-term retention, margin, and customer-quality effects remain uncertain, so memory_73 should be checked before ruling it out.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. The confirmed shortened-flow result directly addresses the current completion and activation declines while improving time-to-value and 30-day retention. SMB signup simplification also lifted activation and qualified revenue, though its slight retention decline warrants cohort-level retention guardrails. Reject promotional pricing despite its acquisition lift because the discounted cohort had sharply worse retention and failed to survive first renewal, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.
